-- WV Senate: Rachel Fetty Anderson wins Democratic primary
UPDATE senate_races 
SET primary_winner = 'Rachel Fetty Anderson', 
    primary_party = 'D',
    candidate1_name = 'Rachel Fetty Anderson',
    candidate1_party = 'D',
    status = 'General'
WHERE state_name = 'West Virginia';

-- NE Senate: Confirm Cindy Burbank (D) primary winner
UPDATE senate_races 
SET primary_winner = 'Cindy Burbank',
    primary_party = 'D'
WHERE state_name = 'Nebraska';

-- NE-1: Chris Backemeyer wins Democratic primary, Mike Flood (R) uncontested
UPDATE house_races
SET primary_winner = 'Chris Backemeyer',
    primary_party = 'D',
    candidate1_name = 'Chris Backemeyer',
    candidate1_party = 'D',
    status = 'General'
WHERE state_name = 'Nebraska' AND district = 1;
